name: Financial Instrument Attributes 5 Choice
definition: Specifies the attributes of the financial instrument.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of a financial instrument admitted to trading.

AlternateIdentification.name: Alternate Identification
AlternateIdentification.definition: Identification of a financial instrument admitted to trading for which an alternate identification is available, such as a tokenized instrument identified by both an ISIN and a digital token identifier (DTI).

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Description of the financial instrument, such as a a derivative, when the instrument is not admitted to trading on a trading venue.
